push.title: W 5-1 vs AC Jarca | You: 10.0 (Perfect Game #4)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, they don't make the rating any higher than that. Perfect Game #4 against AC Jarca. Somebody ring a bell.

THE GOOD
+ A perfect 10.0, your 4th Perfect Game for us. Small wins add up to big ones.
+ 88% passing on 17 attempts, up from your usual 75%. You passed it like you meant every one.
+ 4 shots at AC Jarca's goal. Keep finding those looks; the goals will follow.
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 1). You turned nothing into something more than once.
+ Man of the Match, your 11th for us. Frame it, then hang it where your mama can see it.

THE BAD
- 2 of 4 shots on target. Repeat after me: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger. That's a promise.
- Passes attempted 17, down from your usual 25. Let's try: Drift into the half-space between their midfield and defense. It's the hardest spot to mark.
- 1 tackle won dinged you 0.1. Fixable by Thursday.

Rondo time: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.

PhogsToffees, my granddaddy told me this and now I'm telling you: If plan A doesn't work, the alphabet has 25 more letters.

Proud of you. Go celebrate responsibly. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
buddskees, a 9.7. That's your 2nd best match performance of the season, and you earned every decimal.

THE GOOD
+ 17 passes (up from your usual 12). The team ran through you, and you held up just fine.
+ 2 key passes. You saw passes other folks didn't even know existed.
+ A goal against AC Jarca, your first since Oct 6. Goals are the sweet tea of football, and you poured a glass.
+ That connection with PhogsToffees is gold. Don't let it rust.

- Pass accuracy: 82%. You're in the neighborhood. The fancy houses start at 87%+.

Skill builder: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.

Listen here, buddskees: Confidence is a muscle. Today you got a rep in.

Thanks for making it look easy. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
An 8.5 from tuxedo_slide, your 5th best match performance of the season. That's a good night's work.

THE GOOD
+ 22 passes (up from your usual 12). You stayed in the game every single minute.
+ 2 key passes. You set the table and let everybody else eat.
+ A brace against AC Jarca. One swing, one goal, zero doubt.
+ You and PhogsToffees speak the same football language.
+ This result took us into promotion matches in Division 3. That one belongs to all of us, and you were in it.

THE BAD
- No tackles attempted (down from your usual 4). Remember this: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes. It's coming.
- defensive work rate showed up for you and buddskees. Talk it through and pass runners off and track them into the box.
- Lowest assists on the team: 0 (best was PhogsToffees's 2). Numbers don't lie, even when we wish they would.

THE UGLY
! Pass accuracy 36% (8 of 22). We don't sweep that under the rug. We look at it, then we fix it. Next match: Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.

Garden drill: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.

Last thing, tuxedo_slide. Believe it, then go do it.

Champions are made on nights like this. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
A 7.9, BellyTb1. That's a B-plus kind of day, and I happen to love B-plus days.

THE GOOD
+ 93% passing on 14 attempts, up from your usual 73%. That's how you starve an opponent of the ball.
+ 1 assist. That's what I call neighborly football.
+ You and PhogsToffees were like salt and pepper tonight. Better together.
+ This result took us into promotion matches in Division 3. Moments like that are why we keep showing up.
+ Won your matchup: 7.9 against their best midfielder's 6.4. That's the reliable kind of good.

THE BAD
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Lesson of the day: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized. Brick by brick.
- 0 goals from 2 on target. Start here: Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket. Little by little.
- defensive work rate needs work from you and buddskees. Easy plan: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- Passes attempted 14, down from your usual 21. Here's the fix: Play with your head up between touches. You can't find a pass you never looked for.
- Lowest match rating on the team: 7.9 (best was PhogsToffees's 10.0). That has to tighten up.

Five-minute drill: Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.

BellyTb1, you already know this, but I'll say it anyway: Stay humble, hustle hard, hydrate harder.

Rest up and reset. - Coach Lasso
